prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: roof tiles blown off in a storm. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"If storm conditions have lifted and roof tiles have been blown off, you should make the area safe as soon as it is practicable to do so. The policy does not cover wear and tear, gradual deterioration or lack of maintenance."},{"type":"fact","content":"We may appoint a surveyor or loss adjuster where the cause of damage, the age of the roof or the extent of tile loss needs further checking.
